decisions.reason: Because the education institute extends the firm's existing training, practitioner relationships, and domain knowledge, management can learn from demand and adapt the offer, making retention more likely than withdrawal despite it being less central than the core software.

The remote screen sharing support tool is tightly related to the firm's software support and integration capabilities, so its high fit with existing knowledge makes continued use and incremental improvement more likely than exit.

The analytics dashboard builds on the firm's installed software base, workflow knowledge, and in-house development, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine the product and commercialise it further.
A complete dental practice bundle is very close to the established offer and mainly recombines capabilities the firm already controls, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn unless merely rebranded.

The job and practice listing portal is relatively distant from the firm's core software and support knowledge and depends on marketplace capabilities the firm is less likely to absorb and improve effectively, so resources are better redirected to the core business and nearer innovations.
